cases.description: No creator laptop is under ₹51,750; dropping the inferred use (never stated) finds laptops under ₹45,000.

turns.user: Want a video editing laptop under ₹45,000
turns.reply: No creator laptops fit your budget; these are general-purpose alternatives, not confirmed video-editing matches. My pick is Aeon Air Student Laptop for its mid-tier CPU over Corebook Studio Student Laptop’s entry-tier CPU, though Corebook has 16 GB RAM versus Aeon’s 8 GB.
